title: Suno Hilal Suno
body:
nazar mein leke bahattar shahadaton ka nizam
hilal se shabe ashoor keh rahe hai imam
ye karbala hai ye karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo mein doobi hui dastaan sunate hai
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
<<DIVIDER>>
shahadaton ka ye ek silsila hai ba tarteeb
banegi kal isi maqtal ki khaak sab ka naseeb
na dekh paoge jo waqt aa raha hai khareeb
shaheed honge yahan jaun aur zohair o habeeb
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
palat ke aayega koi baraye qurbani
tumhe khabar hai kayi din se band hai pani
ada karenge bhala kaise haq e mehmani
yahan pe khoon mein doobegi hurr ki peshani
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo laal jo hamein lagte hai jaan se pyare
karenge jang yahin teen roz ke pyase
lahoo lahoo nazar ayenge godh ke paale
shaheed honge yahan naunehal zainab ke
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayan shahadate qasim ka ab kare kaise
na baaz ayenge ek zulm par jafa waale
bhagaye jayenge us jism e naaz par ghode
simat na payenge paamal laash ke tukde
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb zakhme jigar hai ye ranj o gham ki aas
rahega kaun madadgaar ab hussain ke paas
hamein zaeef kiye jaa raha hai ye ehsaas
na kal furaat se aayenge laut kar abbas
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo bhare huwe mashk o alam jab aayenge
kamar pakad ke sar e dasht baith jayenge
phir aisa quwate baazu kahan se layenge
bagair bhai ke qaime mein laut aayenge
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamara laal jo akbar hai mustafa jaisa
sinaan e zulm wo apne jigar pe khayega
nazar ke saamne hoga jawan ka laasha
ajeeb waqt mein aayega qasid e sughra
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
yahan pe hoga sitam aisa ek bache par
zameen o arsh bhi hojaye jispe zer o zabar
tumhi batao ke hum baap hai kahe kyun kar
ye wo jagah hai jahan hogi turbate asghar
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
tasavuraat mein jaa kar zara udhar dekho
namaze asr ke manzar ko ek nazar dekho
nashayb mein tahe khanjar hamara sar dekho
jo dekh pao to zehra ko nauhagar dekho
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan pe khud koi mazloom apni baat kare
har ek lafz pe aankon se behre ashk bahe
padhe to kis tarha mesum kaleem kaise likhe
bayaz e gham hai musalsal hussain ke fikre
hilal aao tumhe karbala dikhate hai
suno hilal suno suno hilal suno
lahoo mein doobi hui...
author: Kaleem Bijnori
